jobs.title: Software Engineer (C#) ID90603
jobs.description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a C# Developer
to contribute to the development and maintenance of an application-protection product built on C# and IL. This person works alongside two senior engineers on implementation and problem-solving, building familiarity with obfuscation and runtime protection. Comfort supervising AI-assisted development and verifying results is part of the role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Contribute to development and maintenance of a C# and IL-focused application-protection product.
- Work alongside two senior engineers to implement product changes and solve technical problems.
- Build understanding of the product's obfuscation and runtime-protection context, including its interaction with customer application builds.
- Break down implementation tasks and seek clarification from teammates when requirements or technical approaches are unclear.
- Use Claude Code in daily development while retaining responsibility for reviewing and verifying the resulting implementation.
- Contribute to adjacent technical tasks when required, using investigation, collaboration, and AI assistance to work beyond the primary stack.

MUST HAVES

- Hands-on C# software engineering skills at a mid-level proficiency, of at least 3 years
.
- Ability to work collaboratively with senior engineers on product implementation and technical problem-solving.
- Critical thinking: break problems into clear steps, identify gaps in understanding, and ask useful questions of teammates and AI agents.
- Ability to supervise AI-assisted development, review generated code, and verify that implementations achieve the intended result.
- Willingness to learn and contribute outside the primary stack, including C++ packages, front-end tasks, and CI/CD
, when needed.
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

- Familiarity with .NET Intermediate Language (IL) and how C# applications are built and executed.
- Experience with code obfuscation, runtime protection, or application-security tooling.
- Experience with command-line tools and build-process integrations.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

- Professional growth
: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation
: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects
: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime
: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Mid-Senior level

Full-time

jobs.title: Integrations Engineer
jobs.description:
What are we looking for?

As an Integration Engineer at Bring IT, you'll be developing integrations between ERP platforms and the broader business ecosystem: CRMs, e-commerce platforms, banking systems, and beyond. Working hands-on with leading iPaaS technologies, you'll design and build integration flows that eliminate manual work, unlock clean data across systems, and give our clients the connected, automated operations they need to scale.

Projects can vary all the way from integrating two internal systems (NetSuite and Salesforce), enabling e-commerce integration with an ERP (Shopify to NetSuite), enabling connectivity with customers through B2B, or connecting with data warehouses through A2A and B2B — you name it. Projects might require working with external partners.

Responsibilities

Lead technical design and implementation of integration flows between ERP ecosystem and downstream/upstream systems.
Design, develop, and implement integration flows using iPaaS platforms.
Develop and consume REST‑based APIs and interface services.
Perform data mapping, transformation, and validation between source and target systems.
Create and maintain integration artifacts, technical documentation, and configuration details.
Collaborate with Business Analysts and Technical Leads to refine requirements and implement solutions.
Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
Troubleshoot and resolve integration defects and performance issues.
Follow enterprise integration standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
Support production integrations, including incident investigation and defect resolution.
Analyze logs, monitoring alerts, and error handling mechanisms to identify root causes.
Implement fixes and enhancements to improve integration stability and performance.

Skills

Business analysis / software engineering / integration engineering background.
Detail-oriented individual with the ability to quickly assimilate and apply new concepts, business models, and technologies. Should be comfortable with learning new platforms, tools, solutions, and business models.
Hands-on experience with iPaaS platforms (Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Workato, Oracle Integration Cloud).
Strong understanding of REST APIs and common integration patterns.
Experience working with JSON, XML, and data transformations.
Basic scripting experience (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
Familiarity with authentication methods (OAuth2, API keys, JWT).
Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort working across multiple systems.
Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams.

Nice to have

NetSuite experience
Experience building AI automation solutions using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
Professional services experience
E-commerce experience
Experience with ETL tools
Experience with databases (Oracle, SQL, PostgreSQL)
